title: Latitude Adjustment Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Beautiful 2-Bedroom Cottage in the heart of Seaside, FL, just out of renovation! Great location, with 1 King, 1 Queen with Twin Bunk. Amazing porches and only a 6-minute walk to private Seaside beaches!
description_expanded: Description629 FOREST STREETKING BED, QUEEN BED WITH TWIN BUNK IN ROOM - (sleeps 6) Charming Seaside Cottage Near DiBicci Park & Ruskin PlaceLatitude Adjustment is a delightful two-story cottage ideally located in the heart of Seaside, Florida, just steps from DiBicci Park and the Ruskin Place Artist Colony. With screened-in porches on both levels, this inviting retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort, character, and classic Seaside charm—ideal for couples or small families seeking a relaxed coastal escape.Oversized Screened Porches for True Indoor-Outdoor LivingOne of the home’s standout features is its spacious, screened-in front porches, located both upstairs and downstairs. The first-floor porch is outfitted with four Adirondack chairs, ample hooks for beach gear, and thoughtful evening lighting—making it a perfect place to unwind after a day at the beach. Upstairs, the second-floor screened porch feels like a private oasis, complete with Adirondack seating for three, a cozy swing, and privacy curtains, creating an inviting space to start your morning or wind down under the stars.Comfortable First-Floor Living & Dining SpacesUpon entering the home, guests are welcomed into a cozy living area featuring a built-in twin daybed beneath the windows and a flat-screen TV, creating a comfortable gathering spot for relaxation and connection. Nearby, a convenient half bath and washer and dryer make longer stays easy and comfortable.Adjacent to the living area is a fully equipped kitchen with a dining table that comfortably seats six—perfect for family meals, game nights, or lingering breakfasts before heading out to explore Seaside.Private Upstairs Bedrooms with En Suite BathsThe second floor features two spacious bedrooms, each offering its own private bathroom and a flat-screen TV for added comfort and privacy. The primary bedroom is a king suite, filled with natural light and a calm, coastal aesthetic. The second bedroom includes a queen bed with a built-in twin daybed, making it ideal for children or additional guests. Both bedrooms open directly onto the second-floor screened porch, enhancing the home’s seamless indoor-outdoor flow.Relaxing Backyard with Grill, Swing & HammockOut back, guests will find a peaceful outdoor space designed for rest and relaxation. The backyard features a pole-mounted grill, a large swing, and a hammock, offering multiple ways to enjoy Seaside’s laid-back atmosphere—whether grilling dinner or lounging in the shade.Your Ideal Seaside GetawayWith its prime location, inviting porches, and thoughtfully designed spaces, Latitude Adjustment is a wonderful Seaside vacation rental for those seeking comfort, charm, and easy access to everything this iconic beach town has to offer.* 5 night minimum in Spring & Spring Break, 3 night minimum for Fall, 2 night minimum Winter.FEATURESLocated in Seaside Proper, offering 1,216 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space528 yards (approximately a 6-minute walk) to beach accessAccess to the Seaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion, featuring the largest private residential beaches on 30ADownstairs lighted screened porch with comfortable Adirondack seatingUpstairs screened-in, furnished porch for additional outdoor relaxationPeacock Alley Linen Partner – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley sheets, towels, shams, and coverlets throughout the homeOutdoor grill for easy coastal diningPrivate parking directly in front of the homeHammock for laid-back outdoor loungingFull-size washer and dryerAccess to three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, and three pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets allowedSTR23-001863
